text.aria-label: Title text 'Only the embargoed three-step schedule lowers the error; the spread columns raise it Horizontal axis: CRPS minus P0's, in points of capacity (negative is better). Dot: estimate (2 seeds). Line: interval from resampling whole months (5 blocks); Bonferroni for 42 tests on counted contrasts (P1, P3-E0, P2, P4, P5), uncorrected 95% otherwise (P4-E). Dashed line: same as P0 (experiment 572's v3+D5).'
text.tspan: Only the embargoed three-step schedule lowers the error; the spread columns raise it

Horizontal axis: CRPS minus P0's, in points of capacity (negative is better). Dot: estimate (2 seeds). Line: interval from resampling whole months (5 blocks); Bonferroni for 42 tests on counted contrasts (P1, P3-E0, P2, P4, P5), uncorrected 95% otherwise (P4-E).
Dashed line: same as P0 (experiment 572's v3+D5).
